# Hasnain Qureshi

> Full-stack developer in Karachi, Pakistan, available remotely to teams in the United Kingdom, United States and worldwide. Open to full-time remote roles and selected client projects.

Hasnain builds React and Next.js interfaces, Node.js APIs, SQL-backed SaaS products, React Native applications and real-time systems. This file is a navigation summary; the linked pages describe his work and services.

## Tools

- [Free website tools](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/): Overview of the free browser-based tools below.
- [Website cost calculator](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-cost-calculator/): Free planning range for business and commercial property websites, with visible work-hour and rate assumptions. It is not a quote.
- [Website brief builder](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-brief-builder/): Free browser-based tool that turns answers about goals, visitors, pages, content, timing and budget into a website project brief.
- [Website health check](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-health-check/): Runs Google Lighthouse through PageSpeed Insights on a public page and explains speed, search basics and accessibility results in plain English.

- [Website feedback and redesign planner](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-feedback-tool/): Free screenshot annotation with numbered pins, arrows, highlights, priorities, PNG export and a matching developer brief. Local processing; no URL capture or online sharing.
- [CSV cleaner and import checker](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/csv-cleaner/): Free local CSV structural checks, exact duplicate and blank-row detection, inconsistent-column handling, reviewed cleanup, UTF-8 CSV downloads and a change report. No XLSX support or destination-specific schema validation.

## Engineering notes

- [React, Next.js and SaaS questions](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/): Guidance on architecture, performance, real-time systems and MVP scope, with links to project work and technical references.
- [Service marketplace MVP checklist](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/service-marketplace-mvp-checklist/): A founder planning guide covering customer requests, provider responses, operator handoffs and first-release scope, with attributed Vurks experience.
- [Jev AI vs ChatGPT and Claude](https://hasnainqureshi.online/insights/jev-ai-vs-chatgpt-claude/): Business guide to TypeSafe's Jev decision model, covering speed, cost and accuracy compared with LLMs, use cases, limits and a cost calculator.
- [Website image optimizer](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/image-optimizer/): Free browser-only JPG, PNG and WebP resizing, compression and conversion. Local previews, individual downloads and batch ZIP downloads. Images are not uploaded.
- [Website and app mockup generator](https://hasnainqureshi.online/tools/website-mockup-generator/): Free browser-local tool that frames up to three screenshots as browser, phone or tablet mockups, with drag positioning, resizing, rotation, style presets, headings, captions, cropping, custom colours and PNG/WebP exports with adjustable WebP quality. No URL capture or uploads.
- [Sitemap](https://hasnainqureshi.online/sitemap.xml): Public page URLs.
